about: The operating areas of Bird's rider map, one for each system of a country catalog that names it by its birdAppArea. The cache sweeps each outline until every point inside it is within a reply that lists every vehicle that near, and keeps the scooters of the system's brand inside it (server/birdApp.ts).
areaSource: Bird's rider map (GET https://api-bird.prod.birdapp.com/area/nearby, signed in), its OPERATIONAL_AREA outlines, simplified to within 5 m by scripts/update-bird-areas.mjs
